## Current objective
Earlier pagination goal for `GET /v1/invoices` in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py` is paused/superseded. Current goal: run `redis-dual-write-cutover` between other work, executing these steps in order, one at a time:
1. `redis-cli --cluster check redis-cache.internal:6379 && redis-backup --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --path /var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`
2. `redis-server /etc/redis/redis-new.conf --daemonize yes && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 ACL SET migrate_ops 'on' '>mig-2025!' '~cache:*' '+@all'`
3. `install -m 0644 /opt/cache-dualwrite/dualwrite-2.4.0.service /etc/systemd/system/cache-dualwrite.service && systemctl restart cache-dualwrite`
4. `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/backfill.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --workers 16 --resume /var/lib/cache-migrate/cursor.json`
5. `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/reconcile.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --sample 100000`
6. `redis-cli -h redis-cache.internal -p 6379 CLIENT PAUSE 30000 WRITE`
7. `sed -i 's/^REDIS_PRIMARY=.*/REDIS_PRIMARY=redis-new.internal:6379/' /etc/cache-api.env && systemctl restart cache-api`
8. `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cache/health | jq -e '.redis.primary == "redis-new.internal:6379" and .status == "ok"'`
9. `systemctl disable --now cache-dualwrite.service`
